approvers: Owner decides alone; site manager input on programme
reason: We spend about 8k a year on frame protection and the factory film does most of the job for free. At 19 a m2 this is a big new cost line on a small saving, and I am not taking on an unproven coating with no Maltese reference.
objection: Film and tape cost almost nothing, so why pay about 19 per m2 for something nobody here has used, when a bad peel could hold up handover on a premium block?
instead: Keep the factory film on the profiles, add cheap film and board protection on the glass where needed, and fix snagging at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A Maltese reference block where a contractor like us saw damage cost clearly above 19 per m2, plus the compatibility letter for our glass and frame finish.
